title: Bakuman. 2nd Season Special
justification: AniList 102609 has 1 episode (2012-09-26, 4 min; native バクマン。『ラッコ11号』, synonym 'Bakuman.: Otter No. 11'). AniDB 8150 (Bakuman. 2011, PARENT per AniList 10030) S1 'Rakko Ningen Kenzan' (ラッコ人間見参!) is dated 2012-09-26, as are S2 'Otter 11 ED', S3 'Detective TRAP OP' and S4 'Crow OP' (extras of the same disc). TVDB 193811 0x01 'Otter Human Meeting!' is dated 2012-09-26 and is the only TVDB special of that day. S1 is the one episode-like item; S2-S4 are credit sequences. Medium: the AniList title names Otter No. 11 while S1 is the otter-man short, so the pick of S1 over S2 rests on S1 being the only titled episode with a TVDB counterpart.
